note: Lake County SD (46079) publishes parcels via Beacon (Schneider), a viewer with no public REST service; Beacon returns 403 to automated access. The only ArcGIS parcel layer found, 'Parcels - SD - Lake County' (1stdistrict.org lakemapnet/MapServer/3), is listed but the server returns 'Service Lake/lakemapnet/MapServer not started' on every request (probe, query, retried). The 1stdistrict Lake folder lists only FSALake2025, an aerial raster with no parcel polygons. Regrid's nationwide MapServer is tile-only (query returns 404) and is commercial; dynamospatial, Rockford and Acres are paid downloads. No usable parcel service or file is currently reachable.
